rules.verification_evidence: court orders, electoral rolls, government notifications, independent reporting and original video may assess an eligible spoken claim but cannot themselves introduce a claim card

source_levels.edited_interview: named Q&A or edited newspaper conversation
source_levels.recorded_short_clip: published media clip with publisher summary, speaker may be unidentified
source_levels.reported_spoken_remarks: reporter-attributed public speech or press interaction, full audio may not be verified

open_questions: Authenticate and timestamp raw September 24 press conference recording, including audience Q&A
Retrieve original October 12 venue notification and October 9 court order, and follow both challenges
Obtain signed peace bonds and magistrate orders from October 10-14
Reconcile state-by-state SIR electoral roll data before making eligible-voter exclusion claims
Cross-check claimed 100–150 coordinators against authenticated organisational records
Obtain written state welfare-scheme circulars allegedly conditioning benefits on SIR rolls
Obtain original CJP/AAP/AEI operational instruction or funding evidence before claiming any link
Obtain June 5 Vijeta Dahiya full Q&A transcript and record what speaker attributed to CJP vs his personal position.
Authenticate July 21 personnel change and separate Dahiya's later personal speech from organisational statements.
Reconcile late-20-July on-stage march pledge with 21-July press conference reversal using timestamped originals, and avoid treating either promise as a completed march.
Obtain the October 11 Press Club recording, police seizure memos and independent device-forensic findings before making any technical claim.
Independently audit August 6 non-fundraising statement against dated bank records and statutory filings, rather than treating a spoken denial as proof.
Obtain and independently inspect the full July 24 MEA briefing and the July 26 official correction; do not translate 'no information to share' into a cleared foreign-funding audit.

Obtain the October 10 Saket Court Ratna Singh order and compare procedural rejection with merits allegations; correct mistaken attribution of nine-hour detention in a Tribune paragraph by cross-checking The News Minute's expressly identified speaker.

Authenticate original Bangla Sahib CCTV and record separately the DSGMC complaint, police explanation and any specific CJP participant conduct. Do not label AAP-linked persons as CJP under assumed common command.
Review the 14 October India Today debate unedited to attribute every statement to Ajay Alok, Rohit Patel, Aishi Ghosh or Rahul Singh individually, not by shared editorial summary.

Authenticate the October 9 North Goa permit order and October 11 habeas release order, and identify the local organisation; do not infer national CJP command or a view endorsed by all protesters from one individual's placard.
Authenticate the October 12 Gandhi press conference, clarify source-based reports of attempted October 13 Congress invitation, and distinguish outreach from acceptance and operational coordination.

Obtain October 14 court affidavits by Delhi Police Commissioner and Union Home Secretary, underlying Raisina Hill mobile internet notification, and Supreme Court resolution of the alleged contempt; affidavits are assertions, not findings.
Obtain the Delhi High Court October 15 application, any interim order and next listing on the October 16 protest; a granted hearing is not a stay.
